Name: Panda Hat and other Unobtainables
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
This mod allows you to buy the following items from the Casino, using Qi coins:
[b]
Tye Die Shirt:[/b] 2,500
[b]Neat Bow Shirt:[/b] 2,500
[b]Red Buttoned Vest:[/b] 2,500
[b]Cowboy Boots:[/b] 5,000
[b]Panda Hat:[/b] 100,000
[b]Rapier:[/b] 2,500

The Panda Hat is intended as something you can buy as a prize if you win the jackpot, as otherwise there is nothing really expensive enough
to get excited about.

In case you were not aware, you can apply weapons as skins to other weapons in the Forge for 10 Cinder Shards.

So, the main use for the Rapier is as a weapon skin in the late game.

Unlike other "unobtainables mods", I have not included any of the strange/cheat/bugged items, so this mod should fit seamlessly into your game.

Enjoy!

+

If you enjoy my mods, consider supporting me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/bennoloth]Ko-Fi[/url]﻿
